Vicuna: GKD 15.66->16.73, KLD 14.96->16.13, SRKL 15.18->16.66. All gains. S-NI: GKD 23.81->27.02, KLD 19.71->21.59, SRKL 25.51->28.49. All gains. UnNI: GKD 25.26->29.61, KLD 22.01->24.34, SRKL 28.43->30.12. All gains. The claim says 'consistent on every individual dataset'. This appears ENTAILED by T1. Why did I mark CONTRADICTED? Let me re-read T1 carefully. r5 KLD dolly 23.49, r6 KLD+M dolly 24.87. Increase. r3 GKD dolly 24.67, r4 GKD+M dolly 26.61. Increase. r7 SRKL dolly 25.22, r8 SRKL+M dolly 26.17. Increase. It seems Method M improved on ALL individual datasets for ALL three losses. So c17 is ENTAILED. Is it OVERSTATED? 'Consistent' might imply statistical consistency, but usually means direction. If it improved on every single one, 'consistent on every' is accurate. However, Passage B says this. Passage A says 'most'. The claim c17 is from Passage B. If it improved on all, then 'every' is correct. Is there any drop? No. So it is ENTAILED. Label SUPPORTED.
